Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the sale of memorial markers by cemetery districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the sale of memorial markers by cemeterydistricts; and amending RCW 68.52.190.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 68.52.190 and 1984 c 186 s 58 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Cemetery districts created under this chapter ((shall be)) aredeemed to be municipal corporations within the purview of theConstitution and laws of the state of Washington. They ((shall))constitute bodies corporate and possess all the usual powers ofcorporations for public purposes. Except as provided in subsection (2)of this section, they ((shall)) have full authority to carry out theobjects of their creation, and to that end are empowered to acquire,hold, lease, manage, occupy, and sell real and personal property or anyinterest therein; to enter into and perform any and all necessarycontracts; to appoint and employ necessary officers, agents, andemployees; to contract indebtedness, to borrow money, and to issuegeneral obligation bonds in accordance with chapter 39.46 RCW; to levyand enforce the collection of taxes against the lands within the p. 1 HB 1819district, and to do any and all lawful acts to effectuate the purposesof this chapter. (2) No cemetery district may sell monuments, headstones,tombstones, or any other memorial marker related to identifying agravesite, when a private, forprofit retailer or wholesaler of theseproducts is located within fifty miles of the boundary of the cemeterydistrict.
